move.text:
Dear partner,
Thank you very much for your message - we are very glad about your interest in our company.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €17.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery DAP.
To be fully transparent with you:
We welcome your offer of 14-day payment terms, which we have applied to our revised proposal to provide a more competitive price.
We have maintained EXW delivery, as shifting to DAP would significantly increase the unit price.
Could you please share the supporting data or forecasts for the binding volume of 6,000 pieces per year?
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 45 days and delivery EXW: €15.80 per unit.
Which volume can you commit to?
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
Our whole team is ready, and we will do everything to make you a satisfied customer.
Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
